_doc: Master dialogue. t = target start (seconds, global). pitch = semitones applied after TTS (duration preserved by pre-slowing). fx = mixer treatment.

lines.text: Eighty-nine minutes gone, one all, and Maccabi are on the attack!
Noa! Eighty-nine minutes. One one. This is it.
Saba, come play backgammon with me!
Not now, motek! I'm in the middle of the game!
lines.he: לא עכשיו, מותק! אני באמצע משחק!

lines.text: No! Not now!
Again?! Every single game it gets stuck!
Because you're still with the old provider, Saba. Everyone switched to GOTV!
lines.he: כי אתה עדיין אצל הספק הישן, סבא. כולם כבר עברו ל-GOTV!
lines.say: Because you're still with the old provider, Saba. Everyone switched to Go T V!

lines.text: Hold on, Saba. Switching you to GOTV... now!
lines.he: רגע, סבא. מעבירה אותך ל-GOTV... עכשיו!
lines.say: Hold on, Saba. Switching you to Go T V... now!

lines.text: Excuse me! Live goal coming through! Live goal!
lines.he: סליחה! גול חי עובר! גול חי!

lines.text: Hey! We've been waiting in line since the first half!
lines.he: היי! אנחנו מחכים בתור מהמחצית הראשונה!

lines.text: Still... buffering...
Get in line, kid. Cat videos first.
lines.he: תעמוד בתור, ילד. סרטוני חתולים קודם.

lines.text: Sorry! GOTV doesn't wait in line!
lines.say: Sorry! Go T V doesn't wait in line!

lines.text: Marseille... the Atlantic... whoa, shark!
Nice try, fishy!
Last mile... last meter...
Delivered!
Goooal! Maccabi!
Gooool! Noa, you are a genius!
Thank GOTV, Saba. No more freezing!
lines.he: תגיד תודה ל-GOTV, סבא. בלי תקיעות!
lines.say: Thank Go T V, Saba. No more freezing!

lines.text: And now... backgammon! Come, let's play!
Did... did we miss the goal?
Sorry, guys... GOTV got here first.
lines.say: Sorry, guys... Go T V got here first.
